hacker_news.title: Ask HN: If LLM reverse engineering is deemed illegal, is that precedent for OSS?
hacker_news.author: apatheticonion
hacker_news.content_context:
With the efforts to clamp down on LLM-assisted reverse engineering - I am wondering;

If LLM assisted reverse engineering is deemed illegal by the courts, is that precedent for a class action that asserts OSS licenses are violated by labs that trained LLMs on that code?

There are two modalities for this;

1) LLM being post-trained against a decompiled binary - then used to output working source code.

2) LLM being used to analyze decompiled binary and used to output working source code.

How can it be "clean room" when an LLM is trained on or reads OSS but not clean room when the same is done for decompiled software?

A learning app you run yourself, on a Raspberry Pi, for the people at home.

Skrongle is one small binary that teaches from courses made of JSON files: lessons, adaptive quizzes, five-minute practice sessions, games, flashcards and an AI tutor. top_trends.author: apatheticonion
top_trends.content_context:
With the efforts to clamp down on LLM-assisted reverse engineering - I am wondering;

If LLM assisted reverse engineering is deemed illegal by the courts, is that precedent for a class action that asserts OSS licenses are violated by labs that trained LLMs on that code?

There are two modalities for this;

1) LLM being post-trained against a decompiled binary - then used to output working source code.

2) LLM being used to analyze decompiled binary and used to output working source code.

How can it be "clean room" when an LLM is trained on or reads OSS but not clean room when the same is done for decompiled software?

source_briefs.item_name: Ask HN: Why does Ant, Open AI even need a datacenter?
source_briefs.content_summary: 用户提问为何Anthropic和OpenAI等公司需要数据中心，而不是提供可在个人Mac上运行的二进制文件。高亮评论指出，像Qwen这样的开源模型可以本地运行，但OpenAI和Anthropic的模型规模更大，个人电脑内存可能无法承载。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这个问题触及了闭源大模型与开源轻量模型在部署方式上的核心差异，即计算资源与模型规模的权衡。

source_briefs.item_name: Ask HN: If LLM reverse engineering is deemed illegal, is that precedent for OSS?
source_briefs.content_summary: 用户探讨如果法院判定利用LLM进行逆向工程为非法，这是否会为开源软件（OSS）许可被LLM训练侵犯的集体诉讼开创先例。帖子分析了两种模式：LLM对反编译的二进制文件进行后训练并输出源代码；LLM分析反编译的二进制文件并输出源代码。提问者质疑，当LLM训练或读取OSS代码不被视为“净室设计”时，为何对反编译软件做同样事情却可以。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这是一个涉及AI训练数据合法性、软件逆向工程法律边界和开源许可复杂性的前沿法律问题。

source_briefs.item_name: Skrongle Mini, a self hosted AI course generator and learning app on R. pi zero
source_briefs.content_summary: Skrongle Mini是一个自托管的学习平台，可在树莓派Zero 2 W上运行。它是一个单一二进制文件，使用JSON文件课程进行教学，包含课程、自适应测验、练习、游戏、闪卡和AI导师功能。内置西班牙语和法语课程，也支持通过AI生成或手动编写任何主题的课程。最多支持8个账户，无需外部服务（除用户自行提供的AI API密钥）。创建者表示这是其理想的学习平台，课程可AI生成或手动创建，提供半游戏化体验和多种题型。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 该项目体现了边缘计算与AI教育的结合，为小范围、隐私友好的个性化学习提供了轻量级解决方案。
